messages.author: b28a3b94cb6f8a9f
messages.subject: Horizontal binning in stat_summary
parts:
Hi,

I looked for a while without success :(
Is it possible to bin values on the horizontal axis when using
stat_summary… This would allow much greater flexibility when
summarizing data will small jittering in x. I wondered if it would be
possible to use stat_bin but I doubt it is possible to call two stats
simultaneously. I'm probably missing something obvious…

Here is some small example to illustrate this point:

library(ggplot2)
d <- data.frame(a = rep(c(1,3,5), 10),
b = rnorm(30),
c = rep(1:10, each=3))

# works fine if points are aligned
qplot(a, b, data=d, color=factor(c), geom=c("point", "path")) +
stat_summary(fun.data="mean_cl_normal", geom = "errorbar", width=0.5,
colour="black")

# if the data are jittered (even tinily), no more summary can be
computed without binning
d$a2 <- jitter(d$a, 0.1)
qplot(a2, b, data=d, color=factor(c), geom=c("point", "path")) +
stat_summary(fun.data="mean_cl_normal", geom = "errorbar", width=0.5,
colour="black")


Thanks for your help,

Thomas

messages.subject: Re: Horizontal binning in stat_summary
parts:

yourself using ddply.
